run_generate_docs_cli: run the docling generate_docs CLI to export JSON schemas for DoclingDocument, Record, and Generic models to a directory
generate_collection_jsonschema: generate the JSON schema of Docling collections and export them to a specified folder
run_generate_docs_clean: run the docling generate_docs CLI with --clean flag to remove existing content before generating JSON schemas
generate_jsonschema_doclingdocument: generate the JSON schema for the DoclingDocument model using docling_core.utils.generate_jsonschema
generate_jsonschema_record: generate the JSON schema for the Record model using docling_core.utils.generate_jsonschema
